text: エリカさんに　やられ　ちゃえば　いいのよ

patterns.name: 〜ばいい
patterns.span: やられ　ちゃえば　いい
patterns.explanation: A verb ending in ば plus いい means 'it would be good if', so it says what the speaker hopes will happen. やられ　ちゃえば　いい = 'I hope you get beaten'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.span: エリカさんに　やられ
patterns.explanation: やられる says the thing is done to you, and に shows who does it. エリカさんに　やられ = 'get beaten by Erika'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing happens completely, and ちゃう is its shortened spoken form. やられ　ちゃえば = 'if you go and get beaten'.
